title: Mango Halloumi Tacos
steps: Cut mango, avocado, cucumber, and red onion into small chunks — keep them small so the tacos are manageable.
Mix the chopped ingredients together with cilantro leaves, salt & pepper, and squeeze the lime juice over everything.
Cut the halloumi into quarter-inch slices and pan-fry until golden.
Heat the tortillas over an open flame if available.
Cover each tortilla with mango salad and top with 3–4 slices of fried halloumi.
notes: Barely ripe avocados hold up best; soft ones turn the salsa to mush. Queso fresco works in place of the halloumi and is lower in saturated fat.
freezeNote: Neither half freezes: the mango salsa turns watery and the fried halloumi turns rubbery. Make what gets eaten.
